definitions.gloss: notification form; official written notice; registration document
definitions.explanation: A formal document submitted to a government office, employer, or institution to officially notify them of a change in status, a request, or a declaration.

examples.japanese: {届出書|とどけでしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届出書|とどけでしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I submitted a change-of-address form to city hall.

examples.japanese: {届出書|とどけでしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{再提出|さいていしゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Because there were errors in filling out the notification form, I was asked to resubmit it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧ (notification, filing) and ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document). Japanese bureaucracy relies heavily on paper forms, and there are specific {届出書|とどけでしょ} for nearly every life event and administrative action.

Common types include ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧ (marriage registration), {出生届|しゅっしょうとどけ} (birth registration), ⟦{転居届|てんきょとどけ}→転居届：10284_tenkyotodoke⟧ (change of address), and ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧ (resignation notice). The word {届出書|とどけでしょ} is the generic term covering all such documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {届出書|とどけでしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a notification form
- {届出書|とどけでしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill out a notification form
- {届出書|とどけでしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様式|ようしき}→様式：05455_youshiki⟧: notification form format
- {届出書|とどけでしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{控|ひかえ}: copy of a notification form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {届|とどけ}: notification; report — shorter, more general term
- ⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧: application form — for requesting permission or approval
- {申告書|しんこくしょ}: declaration form — especially for tax returns
